trip.title: Robert & Geo Take On Yellowstone & Grand Teton
trip.subtitle: A 5-Day Great American Camper Adventure
trip.routeSummary: Salt Lake City loop through Alpine, Grand Teton, Yellowstone, and West Yellowstone, and back to Salt Lake City

days.title: SFO → SLC → Alpine, Wyoming

timeline.desc: Depart SFO on DL1331.
Land at SLC. Collect luggage and travel to Millcreek.
Grocery and supply run near Millcreek — park stores are smaller and more expensive.
Pick up the Cruise America RV at 4125 S State St. Complete the vehicle walkthrough, document damage, test utilities, and confirm return requirements.
Drive north through Idaho and US-89 into Alpine, Wyoming.

stay.name: Alpine Valley RV Resort
stay.details: Pull-through site · check-in after 2:00 PM · check-out 10:00 AM · no generators.

days.warning: RV pickup can run as late as 4:00 PM, which may push arrival at Alpine Valley into the evening. Keep dinner simple and confirm the campground's late-arrival procedure before the trip.

days.title: Grand Teton National Park

timeline.desc: Oxbow Bend for calm water, mountain reflections, and possible wildlife.
Schwabacher Landing, then Mormon Row Historic District and the Moulton Barn.
Jenny Lake: shore walk or boat to the Hidden Falls trail, depending on time and parking.
Continue north on the John D. Rockefeller Jr. Memorial Parkway to Flagg Ranch.

highlights: John D. Rockefeller Jr. Memorial Parkway
days.fromTrail: Oxbow Bend is best at dawn — the light is soft and the river is calm. Schwabacher Landing is just south on US-89. Mormon Row is one of the most-photographed spots in America — the Moulton Barn framed by the Teton range is extraordinary. Sequence these stops south-to-north so the drive to Flagg Ranch flows naturally.

stay.name: Headwaters Campground at Flagg Ranch
stay.details: Grand Teton National Park · Site 317, 300s · water, sewer, 50A electric · check-in 2:00 PM · check-out 11:00 AM.

days.cancellation: Full refund if cancelled by August 14. No refund after August 15. Verify the policy directly with the campground.
optionalStops: Hidden Falls (via boat or trail from Jenny Lake)

days.title: South Yellowstone → Canyon

timeline.desc: Enter through Yellowstone's South Entrance; stop at Lewis Falls.
West Thumb Geyser Basin at the edge of Yellowstone Lake.
Yellowstone Lake and Mud Volcano.
Hayden Valley for bison and wildlife; continue to Canyon for Artist Point and the Lower Falls overlooks.

days.fromTrail: West Thumb Geyser Basin is directly on your route after the South Entrance — geysers sitting at the lake edge is a genuinely strange and beautiful sight. Don't skip it. Artist Point at Canyon is the signature overlook: the Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone with its vivid orange and yellow canyon walls dropping to the Lower Falls. The rainbow in the mist is visible in morning light.

stay.name: Fishing Bridge RV Park
stay.address: 22 Fishing Bridge RV Park Rd, Yellowstone National Park, WY 82190
stay.details: RV only · 30 ft max · check-in after 1:00 PM · check-out 11:00 AM.

days.cancellation: $25 fee after July 18. Deposit forfeited after August 10. Verify in the reservation portal.

days.title: Northern Yellowstone → West Yellowstone

timeline.desc: Leave Fishing Bridge early — this is the big day.
Tower Fall, then Lamar Valley. Drive slowly and allow for wildlife traffic.
Mammoth Hot Springs: lower terraces and, if time permits, the upper terrace loop.
Norris Geyser Basin, Old Faithful, and Grand Prismatic Spring via the Fairy Falls overlook.
Optional Firehole Lake Drive, then exit through the West Entrance.

days.fromTrail: Leave Fishing Bridge by 7 AM — this is the big day. Lamar Valley bison will stop your vehicle; build buffer time. For Grand Prismatic, the Fairy Falls overlook is the classic aerial view — the boardwalk at lake level doesn't show the colors at all. Norris Geyser Basin is often skipped but is the hottest, most active area in the park: the Porcelain Basin loop is 800 meters and unmissable.

stay.name: Yellowstone Park / West Gate KOA Holiday
stay.address: 3305 Targhee Pass Highway, 6 miles West on US-20, West Yellowstone, MT 59758
stay.details: Back-in site · 30/20A water/electric · check-in 1:00 PM · check-out 11:00 AM · Wi-Fi password revealed in Reservations.

days.cancellation: Call 800-562-7591 by 4:00 PM August 11. Text and email cancellations are not accepted.
days.warning: This is an aggressive day that may take 10–12 or more hours with traffic, parking, and wildlife jams. Norris or Firehole Lake Drive should be treated as optional if time becomes tight.

days.title: West Yellowstone → SLC → Home

timeline.desc: Leave West Gate KOA. Take US-20 to I-15 south through Idaho.
Return the RV in Millcreek. Refill fuel/propane and complete tank requirements per the rental contract.
Free time in Salt Lake City, or head to the airport and relax before the evening flight.
Depart SLC on DL2762; arrive SFO at 9:59 PM.

highlights: Free afternoon in Salt Lake City
days.warning: The drive from West Yellowstone to Millcreek plus fuel, tank service, cleaning, and traffic leaves limited margin before the 11:00 AM RV return. Confirm whether the return appointment can be adjusted and prepare the RV the previous night.
